notes: Posted 4 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The post lists no starting section; the objective (posted 'Agents in the Court/ Barely Ever See This Side', the author's joke on the back side since the deck is built not to flip) and Heading For The Medical Frigate are taken as the starting cards. The strategy starts Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route and Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber every game, with Jar Jar Binks, Tessek or Harc Seff as the representative.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace' (under Locations) dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Qui-Gon's' (the deck's one Weapon) dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber; 'EPP Luke' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'Naked 3PO' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing.

Posted 'Ounee Ta' dested the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Effect Ounee Ta (the Reflections III printing is a later Defensive Shield); 'Dont Do That Again' dested the Tatooine Effect Don't Do That Again; 'Do Or Do Not/ WA' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Owen&Beru' dested Owen Lars & Beru Lars.
Yarna d'al' Gargan is an Effect and is posted under Effects.
